thread:
Alice R.: hey team, seeing a sharp increase in SMS verification failures — ~23% error rate for /v1/verify/send in the last 5m. users are timing out on OTP. logs show Twilio 429/500 responses. example log: `svc-notify: sms.send failed sid=abc123 status=429 body=\"Too Many Requests\"`
Incident Bot: New incident created: P2 - Outbound SMS degradation (auto-trigger). PagerDuty page created and paging oncall.
PagerDuty: Incident P-4721 triggered, paging @Matt O.
Matt O. (oncall): on it. looking at outbound gateway logs and recent deploys.
Ben T.: same here, transactional SMS are spiking 429s from Twilio. curl example:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 30
{"message":"Rate limit exceeded"}
```
Carla M.: Is email affected too? any overlap with SendGrid?
Ben T.: SendGrid appears normal. This is constrained to SMS vendor (Twilio). We're seeing timeouts in the verification flow though because the client waits for SMS confirmation before proceeding.
Dave K.: I don't see any recent config change on our side. Twilio's status page shows degraded API in `us-east` region.
Incident Bot: Auto-mitigation suggestion: enable fallback outbound routing to secondary carrier (Telnyx) and increase retry/backoff on send worker.
Ben T.: I'm going to enable the secondary carrier routing now (feature flag `outbound.fallback_telnyx = true`) and bump retry window. applying:
```
POST /internal/flags/outbound
{"outbound.fallback_telnyx": true}
PATCH /svc-notify/config
{"retry_delay_seconds": 30, "max_retries": 5}
```
Ben T.: applied the flag and bumped retries. scaling outbound-worker +3 instances.
Incident Bot: autoscaling: outbound-worker scaled to 12 from 9.
Carla M.: I'll draft a public status update and support copy. support template:
"We're experiencing intermittent SMS delivery issues for verification codes. We're routing to a secondary provider while we investigate. ETA next update 30 minutes."
Matt O. (oncall): doing customer impact assessment — in the last 20m ~1.2k SMS send attempts failed. ~0.5% of new signups affected (blocked at verification). linking metrics: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc/sms-outbound
Dave K.: opening support ticket with Twilio (ticket SID 9A-2026-04-11). sent requested logs and rate window samples.
Ben T.: initial telemetry after fallback: Telnyx route now handling ~40% of traffic, overall verification success rose from 77% -> 91% in 10m. still seeing Twilio 429s for retries that still go there.
Alice R.: good mitigation. can we also increase client-side retry window to avoid UX timeouts? maybe extend timeout from 60s to 120s temporarily for verification flow.
Ben T.: done — feature flag `verify.timeout.seconds` updated to 120 for production rollout.
Incident Bot: update logged: mitigation applied (fallback routing + retries + increased client timeout). continuing to monitor.
Matt O. (oncall): I'll stay on until handoff at 22:00 UTC. action items: Ben monitor metrics + rollback plan, Carla publish status + support comms, Dave follow Twilio ticket, Matt prepare handoff notes.
Carla M.: posted status.redwood.com update and support sticky in #support. copied template and sent to top 50 affected customers via account team.
Eve S.: ping — I'll take the night handoff at 22:00 UTC. notes: fallback active, Telnyx handling traffic, Twilio ticket open. contactable via phone if Twilio recovers and we need to canary back.
Matt O. (oncall): handing off to @Eve S. at 22:00 UTC — leaving runbook excerpt:
```
If Twilio resolves, canary back by toggling `outbound.fallback_telnyx` -> false for 5% route, monitor errors for 15m, then 25% -> 50% -> 100%.
If errors exceed 3% on canary, revert to fallback and notify customers.
```
Eve S.: taking over. I'll monitor the dashboard and post updates here. :thumbsup:
Alice R.: thanks everyone. keep this thread updated with any changes from Twilio or if we need to escalate to exec comms. once Twilio confirms full recover, we'll run the canary and close the incident.
Incident Bot: incident updated: mitigations in place, monitoring. next scheduled update in 30m.
